meta.name: oh-my-issues
meta.description: Cluster a GitHub issue backlog by root cause into a small set of plan-master issues, redirect children with a standardized comment, and bundle architectural-fix PRs that close clusters atomically. Use when an issue tracker has accumulated dozens of reports that share underlying defects, when asked to triage / consolidate / cluster / dedupe issues, when asked to build a plan series or roadmap from open issues, or when routing a new incoming bug into an existing plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 GitHub issue 按根因聚类为计划，自动重定向子问题并打包修复 PR
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 issue 列表里堆满了重复报告，想按根因统一治理
copy.tagline_en: Cluster GitHub issues by root cause into plans, redirect children, and bundle fix PRs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your issue tracker is cluttered with duplicate reports and you want to consolidate by root cause

howto.what: 把成堆的 GitHub issue 按根本原因归成少数几个 plan-master 总问题，各配一份 plans/0X-*.md 设计文档；子 issue 收到统一重定向评论后以 not planned 关闭，每个簇再由一个 PR 用 Closes #N 一次性关掉所有子 issue。
howto.when: 当仓库累积 20+ 个开放 issue 且多为同一缺陷的重复症状，或你要求做 triage、cluster、dedupe 等整理，或要让新 bug 归入已有计划时接管。

say.text: 把这批开放的 issue 按根因聚成几个计划总问题
say.note: 会先通读每个 issue 的正文和评论

say.text: 这个新报的 bug 属于哪个已有计划？
say.note: 会匹配对应总问题并追加 Round N 评论

say.text: 为 plan-02 开个 PR，用 Closes 关掉它的所有子 issue
say.note: 会生成带 Closes #N 的 PR 描述

howto.what_en: Clusters a GitHub issue backlog by root cause into a few plan-master issues, each mirrored as a plans/0X-*.md doc. Children get a standard redirect comment and are closed as not planned; one PR per cluster closes them via Closes #N.
howto.when_en: Use when a repo has 20+ open issues that look like duplicates or share one root defect, when asked to triage, cluster, or dedupe issues, or when routing a new bug into an existing plan.

say_en.text: Cluster the open issues into a few plan masters by root cause
say_en.note: It reads every issue body and comment thread first

say_en.text: Which existing plan does this new bug belong to?
say_en.note: Matches the master and posts a Round N comment

say_en.text: Open a PR for plan-02 with Closes for all its children
say_en.note: Generates the PR body with Closes #N lines
